entries.reason: Calls SECURITY DEFINER tenant/user resolver functions before tenant context exists; no direct table reads should be added here.
Calls SECURITY DEFINER user self-organisation resolver functions using external identity input only.
Calls SECURITY DEFINER device token resolver and refresh consumer functions; direct token table access is denied to app role.
Calls SECURITY DEFINER device credential resolver before entering tenant-scoped device operations.
Calls SECURITY DEFINER invitation token resolver that returns opaque valid invite context only.
Calls SECURITY DEFINER startup checkpoint sweep functions; request checkpoint paths are tenant-scoped separately.
Calls worker-only SECURITY DEFINER claim_next_ingestion_job before tenant context exists; processing after claim is tenant-scoped using the returned organizationId.
Workforce DNA seed/storage transaction is broader-role catalogue provisioning, not tenant request data access.
Bootstrap reconciliation scans existing tenant_workforce_packs for missing trial subscriptions under the migrator/default DB client; request provisioning callers must pass an explicit client.
Worker profile publication is catalogue/bootstrap publication across platform-owned worker profile tables.
Blueprint seed/publication and template catalogue management are platform catalogue operations, not tenant data access.
Remaining direct DB use is platform/no-org audit-log write; org audit fallback is tenant-scoped.
Platform/no-org audit events write platform_audit_log through the platform pool; org-scoped audit still routes through org context or tenant-scoped fallback.
Public health endpoint performs SELECT 1 only; tenant-derived dashboard summary was retired.
Public plan catalogue reads use explicit column-level SELECT grants only; internal plan notes are excluded.
Public installer metadata reads and insert-only anonymous download events use explicit column-level grants.

Self-service organisation creation happens before a tenant exists and explicitly uses the platform pool for org/settings/membership bootstrap; tenant read/update paths in this router remain tenant-scoped.
Platform-only authorization middleware used by platform routers; reads platform_roles through the platform pool before role checks.
Platform-only device console service; all device queries/actions are cross-org platform operations selected from platform routers.
Public/tenant workforce catalogue overlay reads and bootstrap catalogue seeding; platform routes pass platformDb for mutations.
